ai-portal.dropdown-select.doc:
构件 `ai-portal.dropdown-select`

下拉选择器组件，提供选项列表供用户选择，支持搜索过滤功能。

## Examples

### Basic

基础用法，提供选项列表：

```yaml preview
brick: ai-portal.dropdown-select
properties:
  options:
    - label: "选项1"
      value: "option1"
    - label: "选项2"
      value: "option2"
    - label: "选项3"
      value: "option3"
  value: "option1"
events:
  change:
    action: "console.log"
# -- YAML DELIMITER (1nbbm8) --
# <ai-portal.dropdown-select
#   value="option1"
#   id="brick-1"
# ></ai-portal.dropdown-select>
# 
# <script>
#   const brick_1 = document.getElementById("brick-1");
#   brick_1.options = [
#     {
#       label: "选项1",
#       value: "option1",
#     },
#     {
#       label: "选项2",
#       value: "option2",
#     },
#     {
#       label: "选项3",
#       value: "option3",
#     },
#   ];
#   brick_1.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
#     console.log(e.detail);
#   });
# </script>
# 
```

### With Search

启用搜索功能：

```yaml preview
brick: ai-portal.dropdown-select
properties:
  showSearch: true
  searchPlaceholder: "请输入关键词搜索"
  options:
    - label: "北京市"
      value: "beijing"
    - label: "上海市"
      value: "shanghai"
    - label: "广州市"
      value: "guangzhou"
    - label: "深圳市"
      value: "shenzhen"
    - label: "杭州市"
      value: "hangzhou"
events:
  change:
    action: "console.log"
# -- YAML DELIMITER (1nbbm8) --
# <ai-portal.dropdown-select show-search id="brick-1"></ai-portal.dropdown-select>
# 
# <script>
```

### Loading State

```yaml preview
      value: "short"
    - label: "中等长度的选项"
      value: "medium"
  value: "long-option"
```

### Basic

```yaml preview
brick: ai-portal.activity-timeline
properties:
  list:
    - user_id: u001
      user_name: Tom
      action_type: create_goal
      time: 1757853597
    - user_id: u001
      user_name: Tom
      action_type: alter_owner
      time: 1757863597
      metadata:
        after:
          user_name: Lucy
    - user_id: u002
      user_name: Lucy
      action_type: start_conversation
      time: 1757904096
      metadata:
        conversation_id: c001
        conversation_title: 项目规划
    - user_id: u002
      user_name: Lucy
      action_type: decompose_goals
      time: 1757904096
      metadata:
        sub_goals_count: 2
        sub_goals:
          - title: "先计划"
          - title: "再执行"
    - user_id: u002
      user_name: Lucy
      action_type: alter_user

        before:

          - user_name: Green
    - user_id: u001
```
